name: @pipeworx/mcp-pypi-stats

tools.name: recent
tools.description: Fetch total PyPI download count for a package over a recent period (day, week, or month). Returns a single aggregate count from pypistats.org.

tools.name: overall
tools.description: Fetch daily PyPI download timeseries for a package from pypistats.org, optionally filtered to exclude mirror traffic (mirrors=false). Returns per-day download counts.

tools.name: python_major
tools.description: Fetch PyPI download breakdown for a package by Python major version (2 vs 3) from pypistats.org. Returns per-version download counts.

tools.name: python_minor
tools.description: Fetch PyPI download breakdown for a package by Python minor version (e.g. 3.10, 3.11) from pypistats.org. Returns per-version download counts.

tools.name: system
tools.description: Fetch PyPI download breakdown for a package by operating system (Linux, Windows, Darwin, null) from pypistats.org. Returns per-OS download counts.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-pypi-stats forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the pypi-stats pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
